frases: In 2013, Jamie Siminoff walked into Shark Tank with a video doorbell called Doorbot.
The Sharks were not impressed.
He walked out with no deal.
He kept building anyway and renamed it Ring.
Five years later, Amazon bought Ring for about one billion dollars.
Sometimes a no is just the beginning.
videos.caption: He walked out of Shark Tank with no deal. Then Amazon paid about $1B for it. #startup #sharktank #entrepreneur #business

frases: In the year 2000, a small company offered to sell itself to Blockbuster for fifty million dollars.
Blockbuster said no.
That company was Netflix.
A few years later, Blockbuster filed for bankruptcy.
Today Netflix is worth hundreds of billions.
Never laugh at the small guy.
videos.caption: Blockbuster could have bought Netflix for $50 million. They said no. #business #netflix #entrepreneur #startup

frases: In 2008, the Airbnb founders were broke and drowning in credit card debt.
So they designed their own cereal boxes.
Obama O's and Cap'n McCain's, for the election.
They sold them for forty dollars a box and raised around thirty thousand dollars.
That money kept the company alive.
Do whatever it takes.
videos.caption: Before Airbnb was worth billions, the founders sold cereal to stay alive. #startup #airbnb #entrepreneur #business

frases: Three sisters walked into Shark Tank with a dating app called Coffee Meets Bagel.
Mark Cuban offered them thirty million dollars for the whole company.
It was one of the biggest offers in the show's history.
They turned it down.
They believed their app was worth more.
Would you have taken the money?
videos.caption: Three sisters turned down Mark Cuban's $30 million offer. Would you? #sharktank #startup #entrepreneur #business

frases: In 2012, Facebook bought Instagram for one billion dollars.
Instagram had only thirteen employees.
It had no revenue at all.
The app was less than two years old.
Today it has billions of users around the world.
Small team, massive impact.
videos.caption: Instagram sold for $1 billion with just 13 employees. #startup #instagram #tech #business

frases: Nintendo was founded in 1889.
Not as a video game company.
It started by making playing cards in Japan.
It tried taxis, instant rice and even hotels.
Then it found video games.
The company that reinvents itself never dies.
videos.caption: Nintendo started in 1889 selling playing cards. #business #nintendo #history #entrepreneur

frases: James Dyson built five thousand one hundred and twenty seven prototypes of his vacuum.
That means five thousand one hundred and twenty six failures.
It took him about five years.
The last one worked.
Dyson became a household name and made him a billionaire.
Failure is just data.
videos.caption: 5,127 prototypes. 5,126 failures. One billionaire. #mindset #entrepreneur #business #dyson

frases: Sara Blakely was selling fax machines door to door.
She had an idea and five thousand dollars in savings.
She wrote her own patent and cold called factories.
Most of them said no.
She kept going and built Spanx.
Forbes named her the youngest self made female billionaire.
videos.caption: From selling fax machines to billionaire with $5,000 in savings. #entrepreneur #spanx #business #mindset

frases: A new highway killed the traffic to his restaurant.
He was in his sixties with almost nothing.
So he drove around selling his chicken recipe to other restaurants.
That man was Colonel Sanders.
In 1964 he sold KFC for two million dollars.
It is never too late to start.
videos.caption: He started franchising KFC in his sixties. It's never too late. #entrepreneur #kfc #mindset #business

frases: In 1994, Jeff Bezos quit a high paying job on Wall Street.
He started selling books online from his garage.
People told him it was a crazy idea.
Every order was packed by hand.
That garage became Amazon.
Every giant started small.
videos.caption: Amazon started in a garage selling books. Every giant starts small. #startup #amazon #entrepreneur #business
